scope: Commit-derived decimal fork releases and per-build numeric identities

contracts.behavior: Count first-parent fork commits inclusively from FORK-BASE, add the manual base offset and carry patch/minor at ten; 41 commits produce 0.4.1. Preserve canonical revision and full commit provenance through Git-free exports.

Each normal Meson terminal build allocates a new locked, atomic local build number, including unchanged-source builds and later commits without reconfiguration. Independent build directories share a repository counter. Dry runs do not allocate; invalid counters cannot replace a generated header.

CLI, About and read-only tmux-mosh inventory report UPSTREAM-forkX.Y.Z-N without hashes, dirty text or a second binary hash suffix. Preserve GNU ELF build IDs for local stale-build checks. Rebuilds do not restart existing desktop windows.
tests: Meson terminal-build-monitor and isolated input/clipboard suites

environments.versioning: Private Git main histories, temporary Meson builds and parallel isolated output directories
environments.automated_gui: Private HOME/XDG runtime/config/cache/data, Xvfb and D-Bus; no user windows restarted

verification.activation: Existing ~/.local/bin symlink resolves to rebuilt build/terminal/xfce4-terminal. No user windows or tmux/Mosh sessions restarted; no commits or pushes.
